Items have been categorized by their type.

Constructions

Some items are too big to be carried, so be careful when you build them.

Food‎

Food and drinks to keep you walking! Take some time to learn new recipes; they will help you survive in the long run.

Materials

Some items look like crap, but it's not necessarily the case. Materials include all the items that don't fit in other categories that may be used somehow to craft or trade useful items.

Medicine

Sometimes food ain't enough to keep you walking. Meds can help you when at death's door. Beware, don't abuse it!

Transport

Too much stuff to carry? Feeling sluggish walking? Need some more protection in the wild? Fix a nice vehicle and get a ride on!

Weapons

You may feel safe at first, but in the wastelands, you are going to need more than just your fists to cheat death.
